Yes. Public property has been damaged.

But public property CAN be replaced. The human lives taken by police brutality CAN'T.

 I think that's the point. @davidfrum.
#GeorgeFloydProtests #GeorgeFloydMurder #BlackLivesMatter

I wish our political leaders and police were as outraged by the thousands of lives taken by police brutality and systemic racism as they are about destruction of property.

#GeorgeFloydProtests #BlackLivesMatter

@TX_BLU_Girl Yes. But when my teen ran to join a protest yesterday, it gave me hope.  It was mostly younger people. We talked about how change needs the help of the majority to happen & how he had a role to play in #BlackLivesMatter & he understood. This gives me hope. https://t.co/wpTCebJBwH
